name: Sircle
summary:
Sircle: The Hand Moving Game made by ZipordedLabs

Hop in with gameplay options to choose from. Play Gamemodes, Buy Cosmetics from shop, Record a Video at the Recording Studio, Meet Moderators at times. Find Easter eggs, Explore Sircle in many ways that you want!

Inspired by: 
Gorilla Tag, Hyper Monks 3, VTag, Trash Runners, Silly Sircle VR.

Uses: Unity 2022.2 with URP, Playfab, Photon VR Pun.
